title: Test-Time Scaling Makes Overtraining Compute-Optimal
authors_zh: Nicholas Roberts 等（机构以官方论文为准）
paper_type_zh: 训练—推理联合标度律论文
best_for_zh: 需要根据重复推理需求选择预训练规模的读者。
one_line: Train-to-Test scaling laws jointly optimize parameter count, training tokens, and inference samples under an end-to-end budget.
Train-to-Test 标度律在端到端预算下联合优化参数规模、训练 token 和推理采样数。
why: It makes test-time sampling cost alter the compute-optimal training regime.
inclusion_reason: It jointly models training and test-time sample budgets rather than treating them as independent scaling axes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Pretraining scaling laws normally optimize model size and training tokens without charging for repeated inference samples, even though deployment may use pass@k-style sampling many times per query.

The paper asks how this allocation should be made so that extra computation improves the final decision rather than being treated as a free afterthought.

预训练标度律通常优化模型规模和训练 token，却没有为重复推理样本计费，尽管部署中每个查询可能多次使用 Pass@k 式采样。

本文研究应如何进行这种分配，使额外计算改善最终决策，而不是被当作免费的事后补充。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Train-to-Test scaling argues that compute-optimal training cannot be chosen independently of expected inference sampling demand.

The central point is to make that choice observable and evaluate it together with the computation it consumes, rather than reporting a detached benchmark score.

Train-to-Test scaling 认为，计算最优的训练不能脱离预期的推理采样需求单独选择。

核心在于让这一选择可观察，并将其与所消耗的计算一起评估，而不是报告一个脱离成本的基准分数。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method fits joint scaling laws over parameter count, training tokens, and inference sample count under a fixed end-to-end budget.

Its record should retain the input, the allocation or configuration decision, all intermediate outputs, the final selection, and the computation consumed by each stage.

该方法在固定端到端预算下拟合参数数量、训练 token 和推理样本数量的联合标度律。

其记录应保留输入、分配或配置决定、所有中间输出、最终选择，以及每个阶段消耗的计算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper uses eight downstream tasks and reports that accounting for test-time samples favors an overtraining regime outside standard pretraining optima.

This supports the stated mechanism in the reported setup, but it should be read under matched cost and with all auxiliary computation included.

论文使用八个下游任务，并报告当计入测试时样本后，会偏向标准预训练最优点之外的过训练区间。

这支持了报告设置中的所述机制，但应在成本匹配且计入所有辅助计算的条件下解读。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Compared with a fixed inference recipe, it changes the objective from training efficiency alone to the total cost of producing successful answers after deployment.

The contribution is therefore an auditable decision about how to spend inference resources, not merely a larger nominal budget.

与固定推理配方相比，它把目标从单独的训练效率改变为部署后产生成功答案的总成本。

因此，贡献是关于如何花费推理资源的可审计决策，而不只是更大的名义预算。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The optimum depends on the assumed demand, pass@k model, hardware prices, and task distribution; changes in serving conditions can move it.
最优点取决于假设的需求、Pass@k 模型、硬件价格和任务分布；服务条件变化可能移动该最优点。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it for capacity planning when a model will be sampled repeatedly, and compare training and inference decisions in one cost ledger.
当模型将被重复采样时可用于容量规划，并在一个成本账本中比较训练和推理决策。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Do not call a recipe compute-optimal without stating the predicted deployment volume, samples per query, task metric, and all training and serving assumptions.
若未说明预测部署量、每个查询的样本数、任务度量以及所有训练和服务假设，就不能称一个配方为计算最优。
